pages.title: Conduit Cages
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Feed a **Conduit Cage** a fluid through its bottom face to awaken it. Water gives Conduit Power nearby.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Air blown through an awakened cage makes a **Channeling** fan stream.
- Channeling recipes are in JEI under Conduit Channeling.

**Create: Aquatic Ambitions** ties Minecraft's ocean items to Create. Its centrepiece is the **Conduit Cage**: a compact conduit you feed with a fluid through its **bottom face**. A fed cage is **awakened**.

pages.title: Conduit Cage
pages.text: Awakened with water it gives the Conduit Power effect nearby. Other fluids give other effects.
The cage's mode slot picks who is affected: everyone, players, friendly mobs, players and friendly mobs, or monsters. Its effects are listed in the item's tooltip, so check there.

Awakened cages also work as a [#](2E5AAC)[fan](entry://create_basics/fans)[#]() processor. Air blown through one makes a **Channeling** stream, and extra water layers dilute it into [#](7A3C9A)[washing](entry://glossary/washing)[#](). The classic Conduit ring works the same way.

Channeling can:

- revive dead coral
- turn flint into Prismarine Shards
- turn glowstone dust into Prismarine Crystals
- turn an Ender Eye into a Heart of the Sea
- age copper blocks

Look up recipes in [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() under Conduit Channeling.

pages.title: Prismarine Alloy
pages.text: Mixed from Prismarine and Copper Nuggets. Prismarine also smelts into Veridium.

pages.title: Suspicious Rock
pages.text: Wash or channel it for Nautilus Shells, bones and Spiky Shells. Shells crush into bone meal and XP.

Prismarine is also crushable for lapis and Create [XP nuggets](item://create:experience_nugget), so ocean monuments become a source of materials: see [#](2E5AAC)[Underwater Places](entry://ocean/underwater_places)[#](). Gravel, Calcium Rich Powder and lava [#](7A3C9A)[compact](entry://glossary/compacting)[#]() into calcite.
